name: Surveyor's Eye
description: An unknown site shows whether it is a fight or not.

name: Deploy Waystation
description: A pocket rest on this hex, giving one use of a quarter-heal and +3 Essence, plus a supply anchor while it stands. Expires with the expedition.

name: Clockwork Skimmer
description: Take a known stash or shrine within 6 tiles without walking to it.

name: Fulminant Charge
description: Rig the current hex: the first patrol to enter is stunned for 4 party steps.
